explanation: Finds the top five BDCs with at least 50 debt holdings that have the highest proportion of debt holdings carrying a PIK rate, using holdings_v.

history.question: Among BDCs with at least 50 debt holdings, which five have the highest share of debt holdings carrying a PIK rate?
history.sql: SELECT bdc, COUNT(*) AS total_debt_holdings, SUM(CASE WHEN pik_rate IS NOT NULL AND pik_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pik_debt_holdings, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pik_rate IS NOT NULL AND pik_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS share_pik FROM holdings_v WHERE is_debt = 1 GROUP BY bdc HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY share_pik DESC LIMIT 5
